pathways.name: Chemokine Signaling
pathways.description: Chemokine-receptor interactions directing leukocyte migration and lymphoid organization.

pathways.name: Coagulation Cascade
pathways.description: Plasma coagulation factors and fibrinolysis; a hub for cardiovascular and thrombotic disease.

pathways.name: Complement Cascade
pathways.description: Classical, lectin, and alternative complement pathways for opsonization, lysis, and immune complex clearance.

pathways.name: DNA Repair
pathways.description: Homologous recombination, mismatch repair, and base excision pathways preserving genome integrity.

pathways.name: IL-1 / Inflammasome Pathway
pathways.description: NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and IL-1β/IL-18 maturation; a driver of sterile inflammation.

pathways.name: IL-4 / IL-13 (Th2) Pathway
pathways.description: Type 2 cytokine signaling driving allergic and eosinophilic inflammation.

pathways.name: Immune Checkpoint Signaling
pathways.description: Co-inhibitory receptor signaling (PD-1/CTLA-4/TIGIT/LAG-3) that restrains T cell responses.

pathways.name: JAK-STAT Signaling
pathways.description: Cytokine receptor signaling through JAK kinases and STAT transcription factors; a hub for inflammatory and autoimmune disease pathways.

pathways.name: MAPK / ERK Signaling
pathways.description: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade coupling growth factor receptors to proliferation and differentiation.

pathways.name: T Cell Receptor Signaling
pathways.description: TCR signal transduction and T cell activation; a therapeutic hub in autoimmunity.

pathways.name: Th17 / IL-17 Pathway
pathways.description: Th17 differentiation and IL-17 family cytokine signaling driving neutrophil recruitment and autoimmunity.

pathways.name: TLR / Innate Sensing
pathways.description: Endosomal and surface Toll-like receptor signaling driving innate immune activation.

pathways.name: TNF Signaling
pathways.description: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily signaling; central to many autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

pathways.name: VEGF / Angiogenesis
pathways.description: Vascular endothelial growth factor signaling driving angiogenesis and vascular permeability.

pathways.name: Xenobiotic Metabolism
pathways.description: Cytochrome P450 and conjugating enzymes governing drug metabolism and toxicity.
